title: Can a Heart Be Clean Again?
question: When sin has stained the heart, what is David asking God to do that only God can do?
blurb: David doesn't ask to fix himself; he asks God to create something new in him. What is that prayer really after?

nodes.content: When sin has stained the heart, what is David asking God to do that only God can do?

nodes.verseText: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him after his adultery with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your great compassion, blot out my transgressions. Wash me clean of my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.
I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
